detailed_description:
The target video is a 10-second live-action cinematic scene of hard realism, set entirely inside a detention-center meeting room under flat natural fluorescent lighting, with true-to-life skin texture, stubble, and hair detail, and a restrained documentary-like framing. No subtitles appear; any narration, if layered, uses a unified female voice.
[Shot 1] A fixed medium shot establishes <Subject 3>, the meeting room per <Picture 3>: grey concrete walls, a barred window on the left, a metal door on the right, fluorescent ceiling lights, and the stainless-steel table split by the bulletproof glass partition with two black corded telephone handsets. On one side of the partition sits <Subject 1> Xue Cheng, per <Picture 1> in his plaid flannel shirt over a black undershirt and jeans, iron chains on his wrists. As if struck by lightning, he abruptly bolts upright from the metal chair, the chains rattling violently with a harsh "哗啦——" clatter. His eyes go wide, blazing with venom and terror, his chest heaving. The camera stays locked with no movement; the room's fluorescent hum and faint facility echo sit under the chain noise.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a close-up across the partition on Xue Cheng. He lunges forward and slams both palms against the bulletproof glass with dull heavy strikes — "砰砰" — his face contorted with rage, body pressed toward the pane. The camera performs a slow, steady push-in toward his face throughout the shot as he roars in his low, hoarse, shifty adult male voice, <d>[Chinese] 那个贱女人卖我！明明是她让我去骗房本签协议的！</d> His breath fogs faintly on the glass; the fluorescent light glints off the pane and the chain links.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a fixed medium shot on the reverse side of the partition. <Subject 2> Gu Yunshen, per <Picture 2> in his navy blazer and light blue shirt, sits calm and composed, head lowered, flipping through <Subject 4>, the 笔录 document, with a soft paper sound — "唰" — his fingertip lightly tapping the page. The fluorescent light falls evenly across his glasses and the paper; the camera remains locked.
[Shot 4] At 00:08.500, the shot cuts to a fixed close-up of Gu Yunshen. He slowly raises his head, his gaze through the gold-rimmed glasses going straight into the lens — implicitly at Xue Cheng — his expression calm and restrained. In a steady, wise young male voice with thick texture, quiet and measured in the hushed room, he says, <d>[Chinese] 现在坦白立功，是你免除无期徒刑的唯一机会。</d> No SFX accompanies the line; only the ambient room tone remains as the video ends on his steady gaze.
